title: Firefox New Tab Page Gets a Major Overhaul: AI News Crossword Puzzle Launches, Browsers Can Now Be Fun

content_html:
Mozilla Firefox is bringing a rare major upgrade to the new tab page - a daily crosswords game powered by artificial intelligence has officially launched. The crossword, supported by AI news reader Particle, automatically extracts the day's key news and generates relevant puzzles in real time, updating every day with clues all sourced from the latest news events.

Users can click on related articles at any time to view background context, click on the grid to freely switch between horizontal and vertical input, and use the hint function when facing difficult questions. This crossword is not limited to the Firefox browser; users can also experience it on other web pages through a direct link. By cleverly combining news consumption with puzzle games, Mozilla aims to give users a bit of "extra value" every time they open a new tab.

Not just the crossword, the entire widget ecosystem has been comprehensively upgraded

The AI crossword is just one part of the new tab page redesign in Firefox. The new homepage also integrates a rich widget ecosystem, including to-do lists, timers, stock quotes, world clocks, weather forecasts, privacy reports, and daily images. All widgets are highly customizable, allowing users to drag and move, adjust size, or completely disable them according to personal preferences. The system also provides a "show fewer widgets" option to free up more space for showcasing curated content.

Currently, Mozilla is rolling out these new features gradually to users around the world, with some regions and language environments already opening up for experience. For eager early adopters, they can manually enable it through the advanced settings in about:config in Firefox 153 and higher versions. Although the official has not yet provided an exact full rollout timeline, the official support documentation for the related functions has already been officially launched.

Amid Firefox's accelerated version update cycle and the ongoing Nova interface restructure, this upgrade marks that Mozilla is moving AI technology from a laboratory concept into daily scenarios that users encounter every day - the new tab is no longer just a blank canvas, but is becoming a truly useful information hub.

content_html_zh:
Mozilla Firefox 为新标签页带来了罕见的重大升级——由人工智能驱动的每日填字游戏正式上线。 该填字游戏在 AI 新闻阅读器 Particle 的支持下，自动提取当天的关键新闻并实时生成相关谜题，每天更新的线索均来自最新的新闻事件。

用户可以随时点击相关文章查看背景脉络，点击网格可以横竖输入自由切换，遇到疑难问题时可以使用提示功能。 此填字游戏不仅限于 Firefox 浏览器；用户还可以通过直接链接在其他网页上体验它。 通过巧妙地将新闻消费与益智游戏结合起来，Mozilla 的目标是让用户每次打开新标签时都能获得一点“额外价值”。

不只是填字游戏，整个小部件生态都全面升级

AI 填字游戏只是 Firefox 新标签页重新设计的一部分。 新主页还集成了丰富的小部件生态系统，包括待办事项列表、计时器、股票报价、世界时钟、天气预报、隐私报告和每日图像。 所有小部件都是高度可定制的，允许用户根据个人喜好拖动和移动、调整大小或完全禁用它们。 该系统还提供“显示更少的小部件”选项，以释放更多空间来展示精选内容。

目前，Mozilla 正在向全球用户逐步推出这些新功能，部分地区和语言环境已经开放体验。 对于热切的早期采用者来说，他们可以通过 Firefox 153 及更高版本中 about:config 中的高级设置手动启用它。 虽然官方尚未给出确切的完整上线时间表，但相关功能的官方支持文档已经正式上线。

在Firefox版本更新周期加快和Nova界面重构持续进行的背景下，此次升级标志着Mozilla正在将AI技术从实验室概念转移到用户每天都会遇到的日常场景——​​新标签页不再只是一张空白的画布，而是正在成为一个真正有用的信息中心。
